about: Upgrade your experience with the Deluxe Edition which includes: - The Sinking City Remastered game - Worshippers of the Necronomicon: Three quests in which Charles Reed sets out in search of mysterious spell books that harbor unspeakable powers.
- Merciful Madness: Three quests that explore Lovecraft’s iconic stories and bring to light the mysteries of Oakmont and its deranged citizens.
- Investigator Pack: Upgrade your gaming experience with an exclusive private investigator outfit and access to a first aid kit, antipsychotics and a crafting materials starter pack.
- Chicago Organ Grinder: This DLC grants early access to the most powerful weapon in the game, the Tommy gun, and comes with a golden skin of the weapon.
- Experience Boost: This DLC includes a skill point that can be used from the start of the game. Use it wisely to upgrade your combat skills, vigor or mind.

Game Description: The Sinking City is an adventure and investigation game set in an open world inspired by the universe of H.P. Lovecraft, the master of Horror. The half-submerged city of Oakmont is gripped by supernatural forces.
